Grzegórzki (dzielnica 2) — Kraków, Poland

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Consistently identified as Kraków's safest district across every source checked. In the 2024 police breakdown it recorded the lowest counts of any district grouping in the city (154 property thefts, 4 vehicle thefts, 8 burglaries, 8 robberies, 4 bodily injuries, 4 fights); the 2022 breakdown found the same pattern (256 thefts, 3 vehicle thefts, 26 burglaries, 2 sexual offences, 4 fights, again the lowest citywide). The 2020 Otodom resident-safety survey independently corroborates this with one of the city's highest ratings, 4.04/5. Sources checked: Kraków Nasze Miasto (2024 police district data); Portal Samorządowy (2022 police district data); Otodom District Ranking 2020.
